gascityCockpit.ghostex.gxPath.markdownDescription: Path to the Ghostex `gx` CLI binary. Default `gx` (resolved on `PATH`). Set an absolute path if `gx` is not on the editor's `PATH`.

gascityCockpit.ghostex.gxserverUrl.markdownDescription: Base URL of the gxserver RPC daemon (e.g. `http://127.0.0.1:58744`). Leave empty to use the documented local default. Overrides discovery.

gascityCockpit.ghostex.gxserverToken.markdownDescription: Bearer token for gxserver, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Leave empty to read it from `~/.ghostex/gxserver/auth/token`.

gascityCockpit.ghostex.pollSeconds.markdownDescription: How often (seconds) to re-probe gxserver `/api/health` for liveness while the Ghostex view is in use.

gascityCockpit.ghostex.reconnectBackoffM.markdownDescription: Base delay (ms) for exponential backoff when reconnecting the gxserver `/api/events` WebSocket. The ceiling is fixed at 15s.
